# VIVCOM

> Sydney, NSW-based technology services company. VIVCOM delivers on-site low-voltage/telecom installations across Sydney and NSW, plus remote enterprise IT consulting and automation. Licensed & insured, 12+ years experience.

## Local installation services (Sydney & NSW, on-site)

- [Security Camera Installation](https://vivcom.com.au/#cctv): CCTV and security camera systems with remote monitoring and HD night vision.
- [Network & Data Cabling](https://vivcom.com.au/#telecom): Structured cabling (Cat6/6A, fibre) and data point installation.
- [Wireless & Wi-Fi Installation](https://vivcom.com.au/#wireless): Wi-Fi and mesh network setup with coverage assessment.
- [Security & Alarm Systems](https://vivcom.com.au/#security): Alarm installation, access control, and intercom systems.
- [Datacenter Smart Hands](https://vivcom.com.au/#smart-hands): On-site remote-hands support at NSW datacenters for companies without local staff — cabling, hardware swaps, power cycling, visual inspections, rack-and-stack.

## Consulting & automation services (remote, Australia-wide)

- [Data Centre Automation](https://vivcom.com.au/#automation): VXLAN EVPN fabric design, Infrastructure as Code (Ansible, Terraform), legacy migration.
- [Cybersecurity & Compliance](https://vivcom.com.au/#compliance): HIPAA, PCI-DSS, IEC 62443, and ISO 42001 AI Governance advisory.
- [Cloud Infrastructure](https://vivcom.com.au/#cloud): AWS/Azure architecture, Kubernetes, CI/CD, hybrid cloud connectivity.
